title: Phrasal verbs 5 on/off (2)
subtitle: on = продолжать, get on, doze off, show off, tell off, put off

items: go on — продолжаться: The film went on for three hours.
go on / carry on doing — продолжать делать; go on / carry on with something — продолжать что-то.
keep on doing (= keep doing) — всё время, снова и снова делать.
drive on / walk on / play on — ехать / идти / играть дальше.

head: Выражение
Значение
rows: продвигаться, справляться: How are you getting on?

items: doze off / drop off / nod off — задремать, уснуть.
rip somebody off — обмануть, содрать деньги; be ripped off — переплатить.

theory.text: «Мы с ним хорошо ладим» — We get on well / I get on well with him, а не get on with each other good. После go on / carry on / keep on глагол идёт с -ing: keep on asking.

en: The party went on until the morning.
The party went on till the morning.
The party went on until morning.
The party went on till morning.
The party carried on until the morning.

items.ru: (оборот с keep) Он постоянно меня перебивает.
en: He keeps on interrupting me.
He keeps interrupting me.
Don't stop, go on reading.
Don't stop, carry on reading.
Don't stop, keep on reading.
Don't stop, keep reading.

I don't want to carry on living in this city.
I don't want to keep living in this town.

Get on with your work, I'll wait.
Shall we stop here or drive on?

Shall we stop here or go on?
Should we stop here or go on?
Shall we stop here or keep going?
Should we stop here or keep going?

How are you getting on at the new school?

Kate gets along well with her sister.

My boss and I don't get on well.

I've got to get on with my studies.

The car alarm went off in the night.
Stop showing off!

items.ru: Он просто хвастается своей новой машиной.
en: He's just showing off his new car.
He's just showing his new car off.

items.ru: Ты слишком много заплатил, тебя надули.
en: You paid too much, you were ripped off.

items.ru: Плохая погода отбила у нас охоту идти на пляж.
en: The bad weather put us off going to the beach.

items.ru: Что тебя оттолкнуло от этой квартиры?
